FN-JDS5NNY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 218
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Neil Rafferty
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/20/2025
House Bill 218 as introduced would decrease sales receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
approximately $800 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, based on information provided by
the entity, by exempting the Lieutenant General Victor "Brute" Krulak Detachment from the
payment of state sales and use taxes.
This bill could also decrease sales and use tax receipts to the following funds by the estimated
annual amounts shown, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, based on information provided by the
entity, if the respective local governments adopt an exemption from local sales and use tax,
pursuant to this bill:
County Funds ($400)
Municipal Funds ($800)
